prose: SCMP reports on a Center for Technology & Statecraft study: Chinese-owned fabs had acquired about 343 immersion DUV lithography systems by early 2026, around 270 from ASML. DUV is less advanced than EUV but can be adapted for 7-nm logic and advanced memory used in AI chips.
Former US export control officials Nicholas Brown and Saif Khan urge Washington and allies to stop further exports, feeding the debate over a total blockade.
highlights: ~343 immersion DUV tools in Chinese fabs by early 2026, ~270 from ASML.
DUV can be adapted to 7-nm logic and advanced memory.
Authors want further exports shut down.
Report published late September by a new Washington group.
